brief: Carries out the ShedSource action of a response plan by blocking a source in a rate limiter.
detail: A response plan proposes containment as data; a responder performs one verb for real once a committing actor approves. This one answers ShedSource only, by calling BlockFor on the limiter it holds, so the source is refused by Allow whether or not it had a limit. A duration of 0 blocks until the limiter's Unblock. Every other verb raises an error that names the responder to wire, rather than pretending. It holds the limiter by reference.
receiver:
oRL = new stzRateLimiter("front")
o1 = new stzRateLimiterResponder(oRL, 0)
